Question Choices: The teacher made a bar graph of favorite playground activities. How many children chose sliding?
Solution: Read the sliding bar against the numbered vertical scale. It reaches 9, so 9 children chose sliding.

Question Choices: The teacher made a bar graph of favorite playground activities. How many children chose Playing tag?
Solution: The playing-tag bar reaches 11 on the vertical scale. Eleven children chose playing tag.

Question Choices: Fill: How many MORE children chose playing tag than monkey bars? __
Solution: Playing tag has 11 children and monkey bars has 4. Subtract: 11-4 = 7 more children.

Question Choices: Select. Which activity is the MOST popular?: ~~Swinging | Sliding | Monkey-Bars | Playing-Tag~~
Solution: The playing-tag bar is tallest and reaches 11, more than 6, 9 or 4. Select Playing-Tag.

Question Choices: How many MORE children chose sliding than swinging?
Solution: Sliding has 9 children and swinging has 6. Subtract: 9-6 = 3 more children.

Question Choices: How many children in total like playing tag and swinging?
Solution: Playing tag has 11 children and swinging has 6. Add: 11+6 = 17 children.

Question Choices: Fill: Books read on Tuesday and Thursday total = ____
